overrides.s9-p0: The scripts, the prompts, the per-item scores and the curve as a table are in the repository on GitHub, linked here. Five commands reproduce the run for about two cents. Legal Bench is by Guha and others, 2023, released under a Creative Commons attribution licence.

pages.title: Nobody Reports the Misses: Counting False Passes in AI for Regulated Work
CrossSource: measuring whether a RAG system can be trusted to cite the law

overrides.s0-stats: Items: 150. Opinions: 45. Topics: 15. Rater kappa: 0.98 and 0.84.
overrides.s2-list: Version 0.3 dataset: 150 items, 75 Q A citation and 75 citation check, over 45 public U S opinions from Court Listener, 27 federal circuit and 18 state supreme court, 2018 or later, across 15 legal topics. Provenance: every item carries its opinion ID, URL, the exact passage and the cited authority. Labelling: a written protocol, the labelling protocol file, version 1.1. Items are model-drafted and model-checked; no human labelled every item. Agreement: two blind, independent model raters. Cohen's kappa 0.98 on citation check, 0.84 on Q A citation. Adjudication: every disagreement plus a 10 percent audit sample, 30 items in all, adjudicated by me with a third independent model rater. 27 of 30 matched the recommended label. Version 0.1 corpus: 22 public-domain U S court opinions, 16 Supreme Court, 2 federal circuit and 4 state, sourced from Harvard Law School's Caselaw Access Project and chunked to about 350 words. Version 0.1 retrieval: BM25, top 5. Version 0.1 generation: Claude, with mandatory inline citations in doc ID, colon, chunk ID format. Version 0.1 golden set: 25 human-authored questions with verified ground-truth supporting chunks. Version 0.1 configurations: baseline, which is citation formatting only, versus strict, which adds explicit citation-discipline rules to the prompt. Version 0.1 scoring: claim-level citation precision and recall, faithfulness, and answer relevance, scored by an LLM judge and validated by hand.
overrides.s3-sanity: Table 1, a version 0.3 sanity run on a 30-item sample, not a full run. Claude Sonnet 5.5: citation precision 0.919, citation recall 0.718, citation check accuracy 1.00. GPT 5 mini: citation precision 0.763, citation recall 0.718, citation check accuracy 0.93.
overrides.s3-table1: Table 2, version 0.1, 25 questions: baseline versus strict. Citation precision: 0.981 in baseline, 0.994 in strict. Citation recall: 0.760 in both. Faithfulness: 1.000 in both. Answer relevance: 0.980 in baseline, 0.960 in strict.
overrides.s3-table2: Table 3, version 0.1, 25 questions: failure taxonomy by configuration. Right document, wrong passage: 3 in baseline, 1 in strict. Missing authority: 6 in both. Wrong document: 0 in both. Unsupported claim: 0 in both.
overrides.s5-list: Instrument the pipeline. Build a failure taxonomy instead of a single score. Validate the judge externally. Separate precision from recall, so you know whether to fix prompting or retrieval.
